name: What is the difference between wrongful termination and being fired without cause?
description: Fired without cause is legal in at-will employment. Wrongful termination means being fired for an illegal reason, like discrimination or retaliation.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between wrongful termination and being fired without cause?

acceptedAnswer.text: Being fired without cause means your employer ended your employment for a non-discriminatory, non-retaliatory, and non-contractual reason, which is generally permissible in California's at-will employment state. Wrongful termination, however, occurs when the reason for your firing is illegal, such as discrimination, retaliation, or a breach of an employment agreement. The legality of the reason is the key differentiator.
